svg.title: Plot 378
svg.desc: Surface, in 3D. x from −1 to 1, y from −1 to 1, z from −1 to 1.

svg.style: font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; fill: rgb(37, 37, 37); stroke: rgb(114, 114, 114); stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; color: rgb(48, 52, 59); opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; position: static;
